entries.note: Recorded on 2026-08-28 with the audit log. Five dependents is the shape of the thing: an audit writer is a single sink that everything with an event to record reaches — the auth dependency, three routers and the lifespan. Concentration here is the design, exactly as it is for the HTTP egress point below; what would be a real signal is a SIXTH, because that means a new class of event and a new call site to review for what it puts in a row.

Raised from 5 on 2026-08-25: /inbox stopped implementing its own authentication and now depends on get_current_user like every other router (finding SEC-6). One more dependent on the auth choke point is the intended shape of that fix — the alternative was a second auth implementation, which is what was wrong.
